The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, confirming the core logic for risk assessment is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.88 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest reported 100% success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite using version 8.4.1. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to resolve if scaling to AWS-based runtimes.
